title: The Wreck of the Coral Triangle
author: Edmund Vane
blurb: Ines Dravenmoor, a mountain guide blacklisted from two countries, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
